items.text: Las Vegas (early week): TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) missed Wk11, Kubiak optimistic he returns. DT Adam Butler (concussion), DT Tim Keenan III (knee), DT JJ Pegues (forearm) hurt vs DEN; DT Tonka Hemingway (stinger) out last game. Fernando Mendoza starts.
Cleveland (Tue, post-bye): DNP - WR Denzel Boston, RG Austin Barber, DE Derek Barnett, DE Isaiah McGuire, LB Quincy Williams. S Ronnie Hickman back from concussion.
Cleveland QB: Week 12 unofficial depth chart lists Deshaun Watson QB1, Shedeur Sanders QB2.
